title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file (pure-insertion diff failure on .moeb/README.md)
description: All pure-insertion patch_file attempts against .moeb/README.md failed with 'All context lines appear in the file — check removed lines' despite context lines matching exactly. A remove-and-restore workaround succeeded but inadvertently erased the blank line between ### vcs and the vcs domain table.
proposed_resolution: Investigate patch_file.rs apply path for pure-insertion hunks. Confirm diffy handles patches with no removed lines. Also restore the blank line between ### vcs and the vcs table in .moeb/README.md.

title: patch_file fails to apply pure-insertion diffs (no removed lines) on large files
description: 4 patch_file attempts using only context+addition lines failed against .moeb/README.md (49.9KB). A remove-and-restore workaround was required, which introduced an unintended blank-line deletion. This pattern will recur whenever an agent needs to insert into a large file without deleting existing content.
proposed_resolution: Fix the patch_file apply logic to correctly handle hunks with no removed lines. Add a regression test with a large file and a pure-insertion hunk.

title: Missing moeb tool: Read (external file reader for exact byte inspection)
description: Used the external Read tool to inspect exact byte content of .moeb/README.md to diagnose repeated patch_file failures. No moeb tool provides byte-level inspection beyond read_file (too large for context) and read_file_range (may normalize content).
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb tool for byte-level file inspection with line-range and exact-output support.
